categories.name: IFC Model Collections
categories.description: Collections of IFC (Industry Foundation Classes) building models, the open standard for BIM data exchange.

categories.name: Point Clouds & Scan-to-BIM
categories.description: Laser-scanned and RGB-D point cloud datasets of buildings and indoor spaces, used for scan-to-BIM, semantic segmentation, and as-built modeling.

categories.name: Floorplans
categories.description: 2D floorplan datasets (raster, vector, CAD) for layout analysis, plan generation, and plan-to-BIM reconstruction.

categories.name: 3D City Models
categories.description: CityGML / CityJSON and other large-scale semantic 3D city and building datasets.

categories.name: Energy & Building Performance
categories.description: Building energy models, meter data, and performance datasets for BEM and analytics.

categories.name: Construction & Site
categories.description: Datasets captured on construction sites, imagery, SLAM sequences, equipment and safety detection.

categories.name: Synthetic Indoor Scenes
categories.description: Synthetic, procedurally generated or artist-designed indoor scene datasets useful for pre-training and layout research.

categories.name: Benchmarks & Machine Learning
categories.description: BIM-specific benchmarks and ML-ready datasets (classification, segmentation, retrieval on BIM/IFC data).

related.name: Awesome CityGML
related.note: The definitive list of open semantic 3D city models, 215M+ freely available buildings across 22 countries, with per-dataset licenses. Go here for every national/city LoD2 dataset beyond the highlights listed above.

related.name: awesome-bim
related.note: Curated list of BIM software, libraries and tools, with a small open-dataset section.

related.name: awesome-point-cloud-analysis
related.note: Papers and datasets for point cloud analysis broadly, beyond the building domain.

datasets.name: buildingSMART Sample Test Files
datasets.description: buildingSMART International's official IFC sample-file repository, currently holding PCERT certification discipline models (architecture, HVAC, structural, bridge, rail, road) for IFC 4 and IFC 4.3. Older community content moved to the Community Sample Test Files repo.

datasets.name: buildingSMART Community Sample Test Files
datasets.description: Community-maintained successor collection of IFC, BCF and IDS sample/test files organized by schema version (IFC 2x3, IFC 4, IFC 4.3 RC archive), includes a full mirror of the Schependomlaan dataset. Note: not official examples, and many files intentionally fail validation.
datasets.size: Hundreds of files across 3 schema folders

datasets.name: BIMData IFC Files Collection
datasets.description: Curated index of ~100 downloadable IFC files (40 BIM models, 3.7 GB) aggregated from public sources, DURAARK (paired IFC + E57 scans), the Open IFC Model Repository, NIBS Common BIM Files, BIMCollab and more, with direct per-file download links and sizes.

datasets.name: buildingSMART IFC 4.3 Sample Models
datasets.description: Official sample models for IFC 4.3, covering infrastructure features: alignments, linear positioning, GIS referencing, structural analysis models, construction scheduling and geometry examples.

datasets.name: IFC Schependomlaan
datasets.description: Complete lifecycle dataset of a real Dutch housing project (Nijmegen): design IFC + native Archicad models, as-planned models per construction week, subcontractor models, point clouds, schedules, a process-mining event log and drone footage. The de-facto standard openBIM research dataset. Note: the often-cited openBIMstandards/DataSetSchependomlaan repo is a dead redirect, use the archive repo (or the Community Sample Test Files mirror).
datasets.size: ~210 MB: IFC models, point clouds, event logs, drone media
datasets.source: TU Eindhoven / Hendriks Bouw en Ontwikkeling / openBIMstandards

datasets.name: Common BIM Files (Duplex, Office, Clinic)
datasets.description: The classic set of openly shared BIM test models from the buildingSMART alliance, Duplex Apartment, Office Building and Medical Clinic, in IFC and native formats with COBie spreadsheets; widely used in tutorials and research.

datasets.name: Open IFC Model Repository
datasets.description: One of the first public repositories of IFC building models (~182 files), a mix of real and test models used widely in early IFC research; also mirrored on Kaggle as 'Building Information Model IFC File Examples'.

datasets.name: S3DIS (Stanford 2D-3D-Semantics)
datasets.description: Indoor point clouds of 6 large office areas (271 rooms) with per-point semantic labels for 13 classes, plus registered RGB, depth and surface normals, the standard benchmark for indoor semantic segmentation.

datasets.name: ScanNet
datasets.description: RGB-D video dataset of 1,513 indoor scans across 707 spaces with 3D camera poses, surface reconstructions and instance-level semantic annotations; the dominant benchmark for 3D indoor scene understanding.

datasets.name: ScanNet++
datasets.description: High-fidelity successor to ScanNet: sub-millimeter laser scans, 33 MP DSLR images and iPhone RGB-D streams of indoor scenes with dense open-vocabulary semantic and instance annotations.
datasets.size: 460 scenes, 280k DSLR images, 3.7M iPhone RGB-D frames

datasets.name: Matterport3D
datasets.description: 10,800 aligned panoramic views (RGB-D) across 90 building-scale scenes with surface reconstructions, camera poses and semantic segmentations of regions and objects.

datasets.name: Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D)
datasets.description: 1,000 building-scale 3D reconstructions of real interiors (homes, offices, public spaces) for embodied AI research; the largest dataset of its kind, usable in the Habitat simulator.
datasets.license: Custom (free for academic & commercial research, agreement)

datasets.name: Replica
datasets.description: 18 highly photo-realistic reconstructions of indoor spaces with dense meshes, HDR textures, semantic classes and planar mirror/glass annotations.

datasets.name: ARKitScenes
datasets.description: 5,047 RGB-D captures of 1,661 indoor venues acquired with Apple LiDAR devices, with high-resolution laser-scan ground truth and 3D oriented bounding boxes of furniture.

datasets.name: 3RScan
datasets.description: 1,482 RGB-D scans of 478 indoor environments captured at multiple points in time, with object instance re-localization annotations, for change detection and long-term scene understanding.

datasets.name: ISPRS Benchmark on Indoor Modelling
datasets.description: Point clouds of indoor environments of varying complexity with reference models, for benchmarking automatic reconstruction of indoor BIM/3D models from scans.

datasets.name: CV4AEC Scan-to-BIM Challenge
datasets.description: Workshop challenge data pairing laser-scanned point clouds of large buildings with 2D floorplans and 3D wall/column models, directly targeting automated scan-to-BIM.
datasets.size: Multiple buildings, LAZ + JSON ground truth

datasets.name: Semantic3D
datasets.description: Outdoor terrestrial laser scans of European streets, churches, castles and squares with over 4 billion points labeled in 8 classes, a classic outdoor segmentation benchmark relevant to heritage BIM.

datasets.name: SensatUrban
datasets.description: UAV-photogrammetry point clouds covering ~7.6 km² of three UK cities (Birmingham, Cambridge, York) with ~3 billion points labeled in 13 semantic classes including buildings.

datasets.name: Toronto-3D
datasets.description: Mobile laser scanning dataset of ~1 km of urban roadways in Toronto with ~78M points labeled in 8 classes including buildings.

datasets.name: Paris-Lille-3D
datasets.description: Mobile laser scanning benchmark of ~2 km of streets in Paris and Lille, ~143M points with 50 classes (coarsened to 9 for the benchmark).

datasets.name: DALES
datasets.description: Aerial LiDAR dataset covering 10 km² with half a billion points labeled in 8 classes (buildings, vegetation, power lines, etc.), one of the largest ALS benchmarks.

datasets.name: Hessigheim 3D (H3D)
datasets.description: High-density UAV LiDAR point cloud and textured mesh of the village of Hessigheim, Germany, with fine-grained class labels; updated across multiple epochs.

datasets.name: CubiCasa5K
datasets.description: 5,000 scanned residential floorplan images with dense vector annotations in over 80 object categories (rooms, walls, doors, fixtures) in SVG format.

datasets.name: RPLAN
datasets.description: 80,000+ real vector floorplans of Asian residential buildings with room semantics and topology, used for data-driven floorplan generation research.
datasets.source: University of Science and Technology of China

datasets.name: FloorPlanCAD
datasets.description: Large-scale real-world CAD drawing dataset: 16,103 vector floorplans (SVG) from 100+ projects, residential buildings, schools, hospitals, malls, with line-grained panoptic annotations of 35 object categories.

datasets.name: CVC-FP
datasets.description: 122 scanned architectural floorplan documents in 4 different drawing styles with ground truth for walls, doors, windows, rooms, a classic plan-analysis benchmark.

datasets.name: Modified Swiss Dwellings (MSD)
datasets.description: Machine-learning-ready floorplan benchmark derived from Swiss Dwellings: 5.3k+ floorplans of building complexes (18.9k apartments) with structural-component inputs and access-graph constraints, used for the ICCV 2023 floorplan auto-completion challenge and ECCV 2024 MSD benchmark.

datasets.name: SESYD Floorplans
datasets.description: Synthetic document database including 1,000 floorplan drawings generated from 10 layout templates with full symbol-level ground truth.

datasets.name: ROBIN
datasets.description: Repository Of BuildIng plaNs: 510 categorized floorplan images for sketch-based retrieval and classification research.

datasets.name: Swiss Dwellings
datasets.description: Large open database of ~45,000 apartment layouts (3.1M+ geometries) from ~3,100 Swiss buildings, with geometry, room semantics and extensive simulation results (view, sun, noise, centrality).

datasets.name: LIFULL HOME'S Dataset
datasets.description: Massive Japanese real-estate dataset with ~5.3 million rental listings including ~83 million images and floorplans, available to researchers through the NII IDR program.
datasets.license: Custom (academic research, application via NII IDR)
datasets.source: LIFULL Co. / National Institute of Informatics (Japan)

datasets.name: Zillow Indoor Dataset (ZInD)
datasets.description: 71,474 panoramas from 1,524 real unfurnished homes with 3D room layouts, 2D/3D floorplans and camera poses, the largest real indoor layout dataset.

datasets.name: 3D BAG
datasets.description: Up-to-date 3D building models of the entire Netherlands (~10 million buildings) at multiple LoDs (1.2, 1.3, 2.2), generated from BAG cadastre data and AHN LiDAR; downloadable as CityJSON, OBJ and GeoPackage.

datasets.name: PDOK 3D Basisvoorziening
datasets.description: The full topography of the Netherlands in 3D as CityJSON, every building in LoD1.2 plus terrain, roads, canals and bridges, published as open data by the Dutch national geo-portal PDOK.

datasets.name: GlobalBuildingAtlas
datasets.description: Global LoD1 3D building models covering roughly 97% of the world's buildings (~2.75 billion) with polygons and heights derived from satellite data, in GeoJSON.

datasets.name: NYC 3D Building Model
datasets.description: 3D massing model of every building in New York City (Gothic-standard LoD1/LoD2 style), maintained by the NYC Department of Information Technology & Telecommunications.

datasets.name: Berlin 3D City Model
datasets.description: CityGML LoD2 model of all ~550,000 buildings in Berlin with textures, downloadable for free from the Berlin Business Location Center download portal.

datasets.name: Helsinki 3D City Models
datasets.description: City of Helsinki's semantic CityGML city information model and separate reality mesh model, both openly downloadable, one of the most complete open city models.

datasets.name: LoD2 Building Models NRW
datasets.description: Open CityGML LoD2 building models for all of North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany (~10 million buildings), with standardized roof shapes; freely downloadable per municipality.

datasets.name: Bavaria LoD2 Building Models
datasets.description: Open CityGML LoD2 models of all ~8 million buildings in Bavaria, released as open data by the Bavarian surveying administration.

datasets.name: swissBUILDINGS3D
datasets.description: Vector-based 3D building models of Switzerland with roof geometries (~3.4 million buildings), free to download from swisstopo since the 2021 open government data release.
datasets.license: Open Government Data (free use with attribution)

datasets.name: CityJSON Example Datasets
datasets.description: Collection of open 3D city models converted to CityJSON, including Delft, Den Haag, Montréal, New York, Rotterdam, Vienna and Zürich, handy small files for testing CityJSON tooling.

datasets.name: Open City Model
datasets.description: CityGML, CityJSON and Parquet LoD1 models for ~125 million US buildings, generated algorithmically from Microsoft/OSM footprints, downloadable per state/county from a public AWS S3 bucket.

datasets.name: DOE Commercial Prototype Building Models
datasets.description: EnergyPlus models of 16 commercial building types across all US climate zones (plus residential prototypes), the reference models for US energy-code analysis.

datasets.name: EnergyPlus Example Files
datasets.description: Hundreds of example building energy models (IDF) shipped with EnergyPlus, covering nearly every simulation feature, useful as templates and test cases.

datasets.name: Building Data Genome Project 2
datasets.description: Hourly whole-building meter data (electricity, water, gas, steam) from 3,053 meters across 1,636 non-residential buildings over two full years, with weather and metadata.

datasets.name: ASHRAE Great Energy Predictor III
datasets.description: Kaggle competition dataset with over 20 million hourly meter readings from 1,448 buildings at 16 sites worldwide, for building energy prediction models.

datasets.name: NREL End-Use Load Profiles (ResStock & ComStock)
datasets.description: Calibrated 15-minute end-use load profiles for the entire US residential and commercial building stock, including efficiency/electrification upgrade scenarios; freely downloadable from the open AWS data lake, updated twice a year.
datasets.size: All major US building types, TB-scale

datasets.name: CBECS Microdata
datasets.description: US Commercial Buildings Energy Consumption Survey public-use microdata: building characteristics and energy consumption for a representative national sample of commercial buildings.

datasets.name: MOCS (Moving Objects in Construction Sites)
datasets.description: 41,668 images collected from 174 construction sites with instance annotations of 13 categories of moving objects (workers, excavators, cranes, trucks, etc.).
datasets.source: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

datasets.name: SODA (Site Object Detection dAtaset)
datasets.description: Large-scale construction-site object detection dataset: ~19,800 images with 286,201 annotated instances across 15 classes grouped into workers, materials, machines and layout, collected from multiple sites, phases and weather conditions (VOC format).
datasets.source: South China University of Technology / Tsinghua

datasets.name: ConSLAM
datasets.description: Real construction-site SLAM dataset: periodically recorded LiDAR, RGB and IMU sequences plus ground-truth TLS scans of an ongoing construction project.

datasets.name: Hilti SLAM Challenge Datasets
datasets.description: Multi-sensor (LiDAR, stereo cameras, IMU) sequences recorded in construction environments with millimeter-accurate ground truth, from the annual Hilti SLAM challenges.

datasets.name: Hard Hat Workers Dataset
datasets.description: 7,000+ images of construction workers annotated for head/helmet detection, widely used for PPE-compliance detection models.

datasets.name: Structured3D
datasets.description: Photo-realistic synthetic dataset of 3,500 house designs with 21,835 rooms, providing structured 3D annotations (planes, lines, junctions, layouts) plus panoramic renderings.

datasets.name: 3D-FRONT & 3D-FUTURE
datasets.description: 18,968 professionally designed synthetic house scenes furnished with high-quality textured 3D furniture models (3D-FUTURE), released by Alibaba for indoor scene research.

datasets.name: InteriorNet
datasets.description: Mega-scale synthetic RGB-D and video dataset rendered from ~22 million professionally designed interior layouts with 1M+ furniture CAD models.

datasets.name: ProcTHOR-10K
datasets.description: 10,000 procedurally generated, fully interactive 3D houses for embodied AI, sampled from the ProcTHOR house-generation framework (AI2-THOR compatible).

datasets.name: HouseExpo
datasets.description: Large-scale 2D indoor layout dataset with 35,126 house layouts (252,550 rooms) plus a simulation toolkit for robot navigation and mapping research.

datasets.name: IFCNet
datasets.description: Benchmark of 19,613 single-entity IFC objects extracted from real IFC models for BIM object classification; the curated IFCNetCore subset is directly downloadable as multi-view PNG, PLY point cloud and NPZ mesh packages.

datasets.name: BIMNet
datasets.description: openBIM-based scan-to-BIM benchmark: 25 real-world indoor scans (116.5M points, 382 rooms, 8,710 m²) each paired with a ground-truth IFC model, plus an IFC-based evaluation framework. Access requires approved Matterport3D terms forwarded to the maintainers.

datasets.name: BuildingNet
datasets.description: 2,000 3D building exterior models with 513k labeled mesh components across 31 part categories (windows, roofs, walls…), for part segmentation of building meshes.

datasets.name: UrbanScene3D
datasets.description: Large-scale urban scene dataset with over 128 km² of real and synthetic cities as meshes, point clouds and aerial imagery, for urban reconstruction and path planning.

datasets.name: TUM GNI Open IFC Models
datasets.description: Open collection of IFC building models from TUM BIM Fundamentals student projects, curated and published by the TUM Georg Nemetschek Institute for openBIM and AI research; also the basis of the ifc-bench benchmark.
datasets.size: Dozens of IFC models from student building projects

datasets.name: ResBIM-IFC
datasets.description: IFC-format release of the ResBIM synthetic residential-BIM dataset: ~600 parametric residential-unit building models exported to the open IFC standard for use in openBIM workflows and tools. The original ResBIM (by Liang, Yabuki & Fukuda) pairs each parametric 3D BIM model with an annotated 2D floor plan, generated via CNN and rule-based methods for BIM automation and 2D-to-BIM reconstruction research.
datasets.source: tsesterh (Hugging Face), from ResBIM by Liang, Yabuki & Fukuda
